settings.intro: We engineer technical apparel that rejects the rugged tropes of traditional outdoor gear. Our pieces are designed with architectural precision, utilizing advanced fabric technologies wrapped in a minimalist, gallery-worthy aesthetic.
settings.contact_text: For inquiries regarding collections, technical specifications, or wholesale partnerships, please complete the form.

settings.title: Shipping
settings.text: Complimentary express shipping on all domestic orders over $200. International shipping is calculated at checkout.

settings.title: Size Guide
settings.text: We recommend ordering your normal size for the intended look. Detailed measurements available on each product page.

settings.title: Returns
settings.text: Returns accepted within 14 days of delivery. Items must be unworn and in original condition with tags attached.
